description: GridCraft: an open-source, clean-room spreadsheet in pure Rust. By ArtCraft.

latest_release.name: GridCraft v0.17.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Ribbon: Font Size value is centered in its box (fixes #3155) by @kenkanuma in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3161
* Data validation and conditional formats: anchor relative formulas on the top-left cell of all areas (#3152) by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3173
* Ribbon test: pin macOS for the AutoSum tooltip, so it passes on a Mac by @Aimarmndz in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3179
* Charts: decimate area top and baseline at paired horizontal indices by @neilcawse in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3132
* check: find volatile defined names with a worklist instead of repeated passes by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3187
* Protection: authorize the sheet a column move changes; refuse edits that unlock locked cells by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3196
* xlsx: rename repeated table headers without retrying handed-out suffixes by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3213
* XLSX: write the XLDAPR extension URI in lower case next to in-cell pictures (part of #2339) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3217
* PivotTables: dense rank ties and the "Count of" caption for Count Numbers (part of #1448) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3219
* Open a web page's table as a sheet, also when it is named .xls (fixes #3166) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3223
* XLSX: checkboxes no longer make Excel repair the file (fixes #2630) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3225
* Ctrl+. moves to the next corner of the selection (fixes #1442) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3226
* XLSX: write page margins as their decimals (part of #1609) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3228
* XLSX: keep a workbook's R1C1 reference style through open and save (part of #2809) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3234
* Frozen panes: frozen columns keep their text, gridlines and borders while scrolling (#2544) by @adifiedio in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3237
* Show or hide a workbook's sheet tabs and scroll bars (fixes #3101) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3239
* Charts and macro examples unquote sheet names as formulas do (fixes #2012) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3243
* A linked cell's menu edits, opens or removes its link (fixes #2120) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3244
* Key tips: Excel 2003 menu access keys (Alt+I, R; Alt+D, S; …) (#941, #2311) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3250
* Clipboard: paste a picture from the system clipboard at the active cell (#699) by @adifiedio in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3251
* Open SYLK (.slk) files: values, R1C1 formulas, number formats, widths (#1481) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3253
* Find and Replace: search only the selected range (#3224) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3254
* Point mode: dragging over row or column headers extends the reference by @Morzilla in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3267
* Options: highlight the active cell's row, as a global preference by @Morzilla in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3268
* Drag and drop asks before replacing data (fixes #3136) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3216
* GROUPBY: total depth 2 or more adds subtotals (part of #1456) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3221
* Draw: the live pen stroke is drawn as the ink it commits (fixes #1786) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/pull/3229
* Copy quotes only cells with a tab or line break, as Excel does (fixes #2225) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/grid

detail.readme_excerpt:
GridCraft

Spreadsheets and data; an open-source, high-performance modern spreadsheet application, built in pure Rust.

A fast, open-source, clean-room take on modern spreadsheet workflows. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
By the ArtCraft team.


GridCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



Quarterly Sales Dashboard: a table with a totals row, conditional formatting, sparklines and two live charts — built entirely from GridCraft commands (File → New → Sample).
